title: A surgery that costs Rs 10 lakh+ privately was done free at Gandhi Hospital

slides.head: A surgery that costs Rs 10 lakh+ privately was done free at Gandhi Hospital
What happened
slides.body: Doctors at Gandhi Hospital performed cochlear implant surgery on an eight-year-old boy from Nizamabad with congenital hearing loss on Thursday.

slides.head: Why it matters
slides.body: The implant was sponsored by the Chief Minister's Relief Fund, superintendent T. Usha Rani said.

slides.head: Children given implants since 2025
slides.body: Since 2025, the government hospital has given implants to a little over 28 children.

slides.head: Dig deeper
slides.body: Gandhi Hospital has given implants to a little over 28 children since 2025.

slides.head: What to watch
slides.body: The external speech processor is fitted about four weeks after healing. Ask: How many children are waiting for implants in Telangana?
